# Turn a year of bank transactions into Schedule E lines, per rental property.

> Free tool for landlords: drop in your bank or card CSV and get rental income and expenses sorted into Schedule E lines per property, with mortgage interest split out, repairs-versus-improvement flags, missing-rent months and a CSV to hand your preparer. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
